title: Jarvis-Assistant-Atif-Project-Planning-Conversation
summary: Massive planning session for building a human+AI hybrid local assistant (Jarvis-like) with sensors/glasses, voice, memory, tools integration, privacy-first local-first approach
full_text:
The user provided extensive requirements:
- Build Atif/Jarvis-like assistant: mix of human understanding + AI, emotions, local-first (no cloud preferred), offline capable
- Integrate tools: Google Drive, Gmail, WhatsApp, local files, etc.
- Smart glasses concept: mic/camera, voice tone/facial recognition, spatial awareness, object/material detection, strength estimation
- Life management: auto-detect tasks from messages/conversations, update todo lists, learn from patterns
- Memory: facts, context, people, locations, home 3D modeling from observations
- Phased approach: each phase useful standalone, modular, buildable incrementally
- Privacy: local data, own system
- Need to archive all this conversation into files, save to GitHub and Downloads
- Create phased project plan with flowcharts/trees, tools, etc.
